item.title: Speaker Johnson says he disapproves of Justice Department logging lawmaker searches of Epstein files
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson said Thursday that he did not think it was appropriate for the Justice Department to be tracking the search histories of lawmakers who are reviewing files from the Jeffrey Epstein investigation.

item.title: Proposed Luzerne County zoning ordinance covering data centers discussed
item.description: Luzerne County’s Planning Commission spent approximately two hours Thursday discussing and hearing public comment on a proposed county zoning ordinance amendment covering data centers, but it won’t be the last opportunity for citizens to weigh in.

item.title: Greater Nanticoke Area school board approves four-year teachers’ contract
item.description: The Greater Nanticoke Area school board voted unanimously Thursday to approve a new four-year contract with the Greater Nanticoke Area School District Education Association.

item.title: Wyoming Valley West school board meeting draws large crowd of teachers, food service workers
item.description: Teachers and food service workers turned out in large numbers at the Wyoming Valley West school board meeting Wednesday amid contract concerns.

item.title: Mears recovers to make Daytona 500; Logano, Elliott win qualifiers
item.description: DAYTONA BEACH, Fla. — Casey Mears spun on pit road, got briefly stuck in the infield grass and missed a last-lap crash by mere inches. After all that, he finished eighth a qualifying race Thursday night for the Daytona 500, good enough to get him into “The Great American Race.”

item.title: Search for Nancy Guthrie now seeks nearby security videos from the month before she vanished
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. (AP) — Investigators in Arizona want residents near Nancy Guthrie’s home to share surveillance camera footage of suspicious cars or people they may have noticed in the month before she disappeared.

item.title: Colorectal cancer is rising in younger adults. Here’s who is most at risk and symptoms to watch for
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Colorectal cancer is a threat not just to older adults but increasingly to young men and women, too. It’s now the top cancer killer of Americans younger than 50.

item.title: Dallas headed back to WVC finals with win over Holy Redeemer
item.description: PLAINS TWP. — As the two-time defending conference champ, Dallas knows what it takes to win once the postseason arrives.

item.title: H.S. Boys Basketball: Crestwood’s defense shuts down Wyoming Area
item.description: PLAINS TWP. — The baskets kept coming. Seven in a row without a miss.
